from pocket_coffea.processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonAnalyzer(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal PocketCoffea processor for dimuon analysis"""
    
    def process_object_preselection(self, events):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = events.Muon
        mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[mask]
        return events
    
    def process_object_counting(self, events):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        events["n_muons_good"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events


if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonAnalyzer()

from pocket_coffea.processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonAnalyzer(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal PocketCoffea processor for dimuon analysis"""
    
    def process_object_preselection(self, events):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = events.Muon
        mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[mask]
        return events
    
    def process_object_counting(self, events):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        events["n_muons_good"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events


if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonAnalyzer()
